feeds.title: Music Tech Solutions

feeds.title: Sound on Sound

Our regular tutorials and practical 'how to' technique workshops offer no-nonsense advice for beginners and professionals.

feeds.title: Mix Online Magazine
feeds.description: As the comprehensive, go-to source for high-end audio production for more than 30 years, Mix gives you access to creative people using cutting-edge technology. Mixonline is the world's leading magazine for the professional recording and sound production technology industry.

feeds.title: Music Machinery
feeds.description: Music Machinery is a blog about the interface of music and technology written by Paul Lamere. The blog features online music discovery and recommendation while examining some of the issues that can make music recommendations go bad.

KVR's mission is to stimulate and cultivate the music and audio software community with a rich variety of content and services.

feeds.title: Variety Of Sound Blog
feeds.description: As a computer scientist and musician, I'm enjoying designing DSP algorithms and plug-in concepts. It's a pleasure for me to share my efforts with other people without having to worry about commercial interests. feeds.title: DJ TechTools

feeds.title: SonicScoop

feeds.title: Roland » Tech

feeds.title: Dr. James Frankel Blog
feeds.description: Dr. James (Jim) Frankel is the Head of Digital Education for Wise Music and Director of MusicFirst. Previously, he was the Managing Director of SoundTree, and before that he was the instrumental and general music teacher for 15 years in New Jersey Public Schools. Jim is a widely published author in various state, national and international journals of music education. He is the author of The Teachers Guide to Music, Media & Copyright Law, co-author of YouTube in Music Education, contributing author for Critical Issues in Music Education and co-author of Making Music with GarageBand & Mixcraft.

feeds.title: Technology in Music Education
